title: Prompt Retrieval Record
description: States, for every distinct visual element in one prompt, which catalog and prompt-vocabulary lookups were run and whether the wording was adopted from a record or composed.

pack_state.description: Identifier of the resolved pack runtime the lookups ran against.

element.description: The visual element this entry covers, such as pose, action, expression, camera, lighting, wardrobe, body feature, or effect.

queries.description: Search strings run against the catalog or the prompt vocabulary for this element.

inspected_records.description: Record identifiers opened with inspect, or vocabulary terms read, while resolving this element.

outcome.description: adopted: the wording comes from a retrieved record or vocabulary term. composed: retrieval returned nothing suitable and the wording was written for this prompt.

adopted_record.description: Required when outcome is adopted: the record identifier or vocabulary term the wording came from.

composed_wording.description: Required when outcome is composed: the wording written for this element.

reason.description: Required when outcome is composed: why no retrieved record or term fits.
